name: The Gilded Sanctum
stub_label: Keep vigil  (rest — the light here does not falter)

plaques.text:
THE GILDED SANCTUM

You stand above the hours. This is the light the kingdom banked toward — undimmed, unforgetting, the vault where the morning is kept.

Walk softly. Every palace you see was promised to someone.

THE DOOR OF THE HOUR

Thirteen bells were sworn to open it. Twelve rang true and one came late.

It does not open for grief. It does not open for gold. It opens for the hour — and the hour is yours to ring.

THE TWELVE'S GARDEN

One bed for each keeper who kept their hour. The soil remembers their names even here.

The thirteenth bed was never planted. There is still room.

THE OFFICES OF THE HOUR

Sound the offices as the day was kept aloft: the dawn office first, then the noon, then the dusk.

Keep the order and the reliquary opens. Break it and begin the day again.

A NOTE, IN A KNIGHT'S HAND

Gone to do what can still be done. If you read this, Latecomer, then do not follow — AMEND.

Seek the wardens you put to rest, every one, in the light their quarters remember. Kneel at their vigils. Kindle the glory. Speak to them, and hear what the dark never let you hear.

When every one of them has forgiven you — or refused to — come back to the light, and ring what is owed.

— A.

THE PALACES BEYOND

The wards of the light: promised halls for every soul the wax was keeping.

No road runs to them. Roads are for the unfinished. When the hour rings, no one here will need one.
